summary: Targeted backend and end-to-end regression testing completed on the public deployment. The ResizeObserver freeze is fixed: desktop and mobile Properties menus open, remain responsive, and Buy navigates to a rendered sale grid. Category switching, hero search, sorting, project/loan/admin Radix selects, and the exact Projects H1 passed. Seven targeted API tests passed. One accessibility console defect remains when opening the mobile header Sheet, and two active Example Domain test projects expose broken/empty content on the public Projects grid.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening the hamburger menu logs the Radix error 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' twice. The menu and Buy navigation work, but this violates the no-app-console-errors/accessibility requirement.

issues: Two active 'Example Domain' records imported from example.com render broken image areas and ₹0 pricing. They appear to be retained QA/import records and should not be active on the public grid. IDs: 8bc9bac6-8bb8-416f-8216-92ef907fbc8b and 8cd7b5a9-f571-493f-8e6d-a3ada66ee81d.

action_items: Add an accessible SheetTitle to the mobile Header SheetContent; also apply the same correction to the Properties filter SheetContent, which has the same omission.
Archive/delete the two public Example Domain QA imports or provide valid project content before keeping them active.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx and Properties.jsx both render Radix SheetContent without SheetTitle. Header hamburger reproduction logs the accessibility error twice under React StrictMode.

Properties.jsx handles its listing request with then/finally but no catch or visible error state; an API failure can become an unhandled rejection while the page misleadingly falls back to the prior/empty grid.

The production build succeeds but still reports react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings in Compare, DashboardPages, RoleDashboards, and multiple admin/form modules; stabilize callback dependencies to avoid stale closure regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (all requested functional flows passed; one mobile accessibility-console defect)

seed_data_creation: None. No projects, properties, leads, or other records were created or modified during this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used throughout. Desktop Properties dropdown showed all four items and a 100 ms timer resolved normally after opening; Buy rendered 12 cards from 29 sale listings. Mobile hamburger/Properties also remained responsive and Buy rendered 12 cards. Commercial category showed filter-commercial-type and removed filter-bhk; Residential restored filter-bhk. Hero query navigation produced /properties?listing_type=sale&city=mumbai&q=Lodha. Projects H1 was exactly 'New Launch Projects'. Loan and admin selects passed. Fresh desktop loads of /, /properties, and /projects had no app console/page/API errors. Mobile Header Sheet interaction alone emits the DialogTitle warning. Cloudflare RUM and navigation-aborted requests observed during rapid page.goto transitions were test-navigation/platform artifacts, not API failures.
rca_of_the_issue: The original hang is resolved because frontend/src/index.js no longer monkey-patches ResizeObserver callbacks through requestAnimationFrame; no such patch remains in src/public. Radix dropdowns now open without an infinite rAF/layout cycle. The remaining mobile console warning is caused by Header.jsx SheetContent lacking a SheetTitle (the same structural omission exists in Properties.jsx). The public project content defect is data-state related: two active records have name 'Example Domain', main_image null, price_from 0, and import_source_url https://example.com.
